lead_raw_text:
The structure of LuZrGe₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 129), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—two Lu, two Zr, and four Ge—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Ge centers with 11 neighbors (2 Ge, 3 Lu, 6 Zr), while Lu and Zr each have 10 neighbors (4 Ge and 6 of the other transition metal). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ge-centered 11-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing between Ge- and Lu-centered polyhedra.
